objective: Verify that the Style tab only exposes controls for filter types and modules currently enabled in Content.
preconditions: Filter Controller widget is available in Elementor.
A test page contains one Filter Controller widget.
The implementation includes per-type style cadence metadata or equivalent.
steps: Remove all filters and confirm filter-specific style sections are hidden.
Add one filter type at a time: search, checkbox, radio, select, chips, toggle, range, date, swatch, rating.
For each type, switch to Style and record which sections appear.
Enable Sort and confirm Sort-specific controls appear independently from filter controls.
Disable each type and confirm its Style controls disappear after editor refresh or fallback update.
expected_result: Style controls track Content selections without showing unrelated filter families.
pass_criteria: No Range controls appear unless at least one Range filter exists.
No Rating controls appear unless at least one Rating filter exists.
Option-style controls are not a generic dump for unrelated component families.
Sort controls appear only when Sort is enabled.
Fallback warning appears only when Elementor did not refresh the panel through the native path.
evidence_required: Elementor screenshots or notes for each type
Guilherme QA notes for multi-click editor flow
